description: Original continuous locomotion. -Z forward, right=-X; upper torso negative X leans forward. Air is a held travel pose, not a jump impulse. Weapon state is selected by runtime.

idle.weapon_pose_note: Shaft head stays forward and raised; hook faces outward, away from the right-hand side of the body. Local shaft roll 180 degrees.

walk.weapon_pose_note: Shaft head stays forward and raised; hook faces outward, away from the right-hand side of the body. Local shaft roll 180 degrees.

run.weapon_pose_note: Shaft head stays forward and raised; hook faces outward, away from the right-hand side of the body. Local shaft roll 180 degrees.

air.weapon_pose_note: Shaft head stays forward and raised; hook faces outward, away from the right-hand side of the body. Local shaft roll 180 degrees.

idle_s.pose_note: Sheathed: weapon on the back (sheath mount in arle.json); relaxed empty hands. Right arm mirrors the left arm; drawn-set torso, head and legs.

walk_s.pose_note: Sheathed: weapon on the back (sheath mount in arle.json); relaxed empty hands. Right arm mirrors the left arm half a cycle later, swinging in opposition; left leg tracks 3.5 degrees inward so the shin passes in front of the butt spike at the left ankle.

run_s.pose_note: Sheathed: weapon on the back (sheath mount in arle.json); relaxed empty hands. Right arm mirrors the left arm half a cycle later, swinging in opposition; left leg tracks inward with a softer back swing and a 30 percent lower heel kick so it clears the butt spike.

air_s.pose_note: Sheathed: weapon on the back (sheath mount in arle.json); relaxed empty hands. Right arm mirrors the left arm; drawn-set torso, head and legs.

idle.weapon_pose_note: Forward blade tip preserved; local shaft rolled 90 degrees so the cutting edges face sky/ground in ready and movement poses.

walk.weapon_pose_note: Forward blade tip preserved; local shaft rolled 90 degrees so the cutting edges face sky/ground in ready and movement poses.

run.weapon_pose_note: Forward blade tip preserved; local shaft rolled 90 degrees so the cutting edges face sky/ground in ready and movement poses.

air.weapon_pose_note: Forward blade tip preserved; local shaft rolled 90 degrees so the cutting edges face sky/ground in ready and movement poses.

idle_s.pose_note: Sheathed: weapon on the back (sheath mount in skirk.json); relaxed empty hands. Right arm mirrors the left arm; drawn-set torso, head and legs.

walk_s.pose_note: Sheathed: weapon on the back (sheath mount in skirk.json); relaxed empty hands. Right arm mirrors the left arm half a cycle later, swinging in opposition; right arm swings slightly forward and out so the elbow stays in front of the hilt at the right waist; the left arm's back swing is softened and opened so the forearm clears the blade tip at the left hip.

run_s.pose_note: Sheathed: weapon on the back (sheath mount in skirk.json); relaxed empty hands. Right arm mirrors the left arm half a cycle later, swinging in opposition; right arm pumps forward of the hilt (back swing softened, arm opened 8 degrees); drawn-set torso, head and legs.

air_s.pose_note: Sheathed: weapon on the back (sheath mount in skirk.json); relaxed empty hands. Right arm mirrors the left arm; drawn-set torso, head and legs.
